hypothesis: If C67's FACT consequence objectives are responsible for its action and LIBERO effect, then the matched C67-s20000 joint arm will outperform this action-only s20000 arm; otherwise the observed change is attributable to additional action-tower optimization rather than future-representation/state/value supervision.
single_variable: Relative to C67, C69 sets future-representation/state/value objective weights to zero and freezes only their six encoder/decoder modules. C58 parent, full 30-layer shared tower, online frozen INT8 H3, model initialization seed, joint-token forward topology, deterministic sample order, 4/2/1/1 rank categories, failure action masks, AdamW groups for every still-trainable parameter, learning rates, warmup, cosine horizon, 20000 optimizer steps and checkpoint cadence remain fixed.
parent_baseline: Both arms initialize from promoted C58B s10000 SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541. C67-s20000 is the sole matched joint-objective treatment; historical C60/C55/D0 results are context only.

references.title: WLA paired action and image_action recipes

architecture.field: same 30-layer H3-to-Action tower and joint causal forward
architecture.paper: World-action attribution requires a world-objective-off control with the same action policy capacity.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT shares action and consequence tracks; FastWAM uses the full ActionDiT tower.
architecture.local: C69 constructs the identical H3FACTLayerwiseTowerPolicy and executes the same P/A/G/V/I masked forward as C67. Only six consequence-only encoders/decoders are frozen.
architecture.rationale: Using forward_action would alter numerical topology, so C69 deliberately retains C67's joint forward.

data.paper: Failure actions are excluded from imitation.
data.upstream_code: FACT mixes episodes and masks failure action loss.
data.local: All eight ranks call the unchanged MixedPools.item with seed20260816 and absolute step. The two failure ranks remain zero-mask examples; they are not replaced by expert samples.
data.rationale: Changing failure ranks would confound objective attribution with sample exposure.

action.paper: Deployment action representation must match training.
action.upstream_code: FastWAM uses shifted flow action chunks.
action.local: C69 reuses C67 normalization, padding, shift5, horizon32 and deployment evaluator without modification.

objective.paper: An action-only control isolates the causal value of world prediction objectives.
objective.upstream_code: WLA publishes matched action versus image_action training; FACT supplies the joint objective being ablated.
objective.local: C69 uses weight vector [10,0,0,0]. DDP scales the six supervised ranks by 8/6, exactly matching C67's action component; auxiliary losses are detached diagnostics and their heads are excluded from AdamW.
objective.rationale: This is the sole intended variable.

optimization.paper: Control and treatment require equal optimizer budgets.
optimization.upstream_code: Distributed action/world recipes use fixed schedules.
optimization.local: Eight A800 ranks, global batch8, base/action LR2e-5/2e-4, warmup500, cosine horizon20000, seed20260816 and 1000-step checkpoints match C67.
optimization.rationale: Frozen auxiliary parameters are intentionally absent from AdamW; every shared/action parameter keeps its C67 group and hyperparameters.

evaluation.field: fixed offline bridge then paired LIBERO attribution
evaluation.paper: Closed-loop success, not training loss, decides policy effectiveness.
evaluation.upstream_code: World-on/off arms are compared at equal budgets.
evaluation.local: C69-s20000 and C67-s20000 receive the same balanced80 diagnostics. Fresh paired LIBERO is allowed only if mechanical and offline conditioning gates pass.
evaluation.rationale: No milestone is selected from training loss.

evidence: Pinned FACT/FastWAM/WLA revisions and mandatory complete read-only snapshot.
Existing C67 model plus explicit six-module freeze; unit tests pass.
Unchanged C67 hashes, MixedPools sampler, rank categories and seed.
CPU unit test proves exact equality to 10x C67 globally normalized action component and detached auxiliary diagnostics.
C67-matched 20k schedule preregistered; canary required before long launch.
C67-s20 is the sole matched treatment; fixed balanced80 precedes any rollout.
Real eight-rank C69 all-30 global-gradient evidence does not exist before canary.
Real ten-step C69 finite smoke not yet run.
C69 strict restore not yet run.
Fixed promoted C58B s10000 SHA256 and READY required by launcher.

effect_preregistration.primary_comparison: C67 joint s20000 minus C69 action-only s20000
effect_preregistration.offline_gate: Both checkpoints must strict-restore and retain fixed visual/language/gripper safety; report normalized and physical action MSE with no post-hoc checkpoint substitution.
effect_preregistration.interpretation: C67 passing proves incremental value of consequence supervision under this contract. C69 tying or winning rejects that value and favors action-only continuation. Either outcome leaves C58 champion until a candidate separately beats it in fresh closed loop.

decision.rationale: Source, contracts and CPU equivalence tests pass; real eight-rank gradients, finite optimizer steps and strict restore remain mandatory before long training.
decision.launch_command: Run scripts/h3wam/launch_c69_matched_action_only_canary_8gpu.sh from a complete read-only snapshot; issue long-run release only if GO_LONG.json says GO_C69_LONG.
